advisories.impact: EventSource parser state can exhaust process memory from a malicious SSE peer.
Mixed-case SRI algorithm tokens can be skipped, accepting a body that differs from its intended integrity digest.
A malicious peer can combine excessive content encodings and early close to leave an orphaned response stream with an unhandled error, terminating Node.
